segments.name: Beverage
segments.description: Brews, markets and sells craft beer and craft spirits brands to distributors, retailers and consumers in the United States and international markets.
segments.evidence: • Beverage – Production, marketing and sale of beverages.

segments.name: Cannabis
segments.description: Cultivates, produces and sells medical and adult-use cannabis products to patients and consumers in Canada and international markets.
segments.evidence: • Cannabis – Cultivation, production, distribution and sale of both medical and adult-use cannabis products.

segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Purchases pharmaceuticals and wellness products and resells them to customers through its distribution network.
segments.evidence: • Distribution – Purchase, resale and distribution of pharmaceutical and wellness products.

segments.name: Wellness
segments.description: Produces, markets and distributes hemp-based food and other wellness products, including the Manitoba Harvest brand, for consumers.
segments.evidence: • Wellness – Production, marketing and distribution of hemp-based food and other wellness products.

revenueModel.text: Independent distributors buy the craft beverages for resale to retailers and consumers; the other segments sell cannabis, pharmaceutical and wellness products to their customers.
revenueModel.evidence: In the United States, each of SweetWater, Breckenridge, Montauk, BrewDog and our other craft brands sells its beverages to independent distributors for distribution to retailers and, ultimately, to consumers.

changes.text: In 2026 Tilray acquired BrewDog, transforming its beverage platform from a U.S. platform into a global platform.
changes.evidence: As the only global craft beer brand, the BrewDog Acquisition served to transform our beverage platform from a U.S. platform to a global platform and provided us with the international presence, team and capabilities to support the broader distribution of our U.S. beverage brands across key international markets

changes.text: In 2026 Tilray acquired the Lyphe Group, a UK medical cannabis clinic and digital pharmacy platform.
changes.evidence: On April 15 2026, Tilray acquired the Lyphe Group, a UK-based medical cannabis clinic and digital pharmacy platform
